name: Palak Paneer
ingredients: Garlic, ginger, cumin, and garam masala
Cream or yogurt, salt, and oil
instructions: Blanch the spinach, cool it, and blend into a smooth purée.
Brown the paneer cubes and set them aside.
Cook the onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, and spices.
Add the spinach purée and paneer, then simmer gently and finish with cream or yogurt.
notes: Avoid boiling after adding dairy to keep the sauce smooth.

name: Chana Masala
ingredients: Ginger, cumin, coriander, and garam masala
instructions: Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add tomatoes and spices, cooking until thick and fragrant.
Stir in chickpeas and enough water to make a saucy curry.
Simmer until the flavors come together and garnish with coriander.
notes: Serve with rice, roti, or naan.

name: Chicken Pad Thai
ingredients: Fish sauce, tamarind paste, sugar, and chili
instructions: Soak the noodles until pliable and mix the sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken, then push it aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles and sauce, tossing until coated and tender.
Fold in bean sprouts and spring onions; serve with peanuts and lime.
notes: Keep the wok hot and avoid overcrowding it.

name: Thai Green Curry with Tofu
ingredients: Thai basil, lime leaves, and soy sauce
instructions: Brown the tofu and set it aside.
Fry the curry paste briefly, then add coconut milk.
Add the vegetables and simmer until tender.
Return the tofu, season, and finish with Thai basil and lime leaves.
notes: Serve with jasmine rice and fresh lime.

name: Fish Vindaye
instructions: Season the fish with turmeric and pan-fry until lightly golden.
Sauté the onions, garlic, ginger, and mustard seeds.
Add vinegar, chili, and a little water, then return the fish to the pan.
Simmer gently and finish with fresh coriander.
notes: Serve with rice and a crisp salad.

name: Gateau Piment
instructions: Soak the split peas, drain, and grind to a coarse paste.
Mix with chilies, onion, herbs, and spices.
Shape into small balls and flatten slightly.
Deep-fry until golden and crisp.
notes: A popular Mauritian snack, especially with chili sauce.

name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Stretch the dough onto a hot baking tray or pizza stone.
Spread with tomatoes and season lightly.
Add mozzarella and bake at the highest oven temperature until blistered.
Finish with basil and olive oil.
notes: Preheat the oven thoroughly for a crisp base.

name: Chicken Schnitzel
instructions: Flatten the chicken to an even thickness and season.
Coat each piece in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry until golden and cooked through.
Serve with lemon and a fresh salad.
notes: Panko breadcrumbs give an extra-crisp coating.

name: Shakshuka
ingredients: Cumin, paprika, chili, and fresh parsley
instructions: Sauté the onion, pepper, and garlic until soft.
Add tomatoes and spices, then simmer until thickened.
Make wells in the sauce and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites are set; garnish with parsley.
notes: Serve with crusty bread for dipping.

name: Greek Salad
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper
instructions: Chop the tomatoes, cucumber, and onion.
Toss with olives and the dressing.
Add feta on top and serve chilled.
notes: Add the dressing just before serving to keep the vegetables crisp.

name: Kung Pao Chicken
ingredients: 600 g chicken breast or thigh, cubed
Soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and cornstarch
instructions: Toss the chicken with cornstarch and prepare the sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken until browned, then remove it.
Fry the chilies, garlic, pepper, and spring onions briefly.
Return the chicken, add the sauce and peanuts, and toss until glossy.
notes: Adjust the dried chilies to control the heat.

name: Chicken Daube Mauricien
ingredients: Thyme, bay leaf, ginger, and chili
instructions: Brown the chicken in a heavy pot and set it aside.
Sauté the onions, garlic, ginger, and chili until fragrant.
Add tomatoes, herbs, potatoes, and chicken, then cover and simmer until tender.
Serve hot with rice or bread.
notes: A comforting Mauritian stew that reheats well.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
ingredients: Soy sauce, sesame oil, and white pepper
instructions: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set them aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables until crisp-tender.
Add the rice and sauces, tossing until hot and separate.
Return the eggs, add spring onions, and serve.
notes: Use day-old rice for the best texture.

name: Dholl Puri
ingredients: Curry powder, turmeric, salt, and oil
instructions: Cook the split peas with turmeric until tender, then mash with seasoning.
Make a soft dough, fill with the pea mixture, and roll into thin discs.
Cook the discs on a hot griddle with a little oil until lightly browned.
Serve with rougaille or your preferred curry.
notes: A Mauritian street-food classic; prepare the pea filling ahead of time.

name: Farata (Mauritian roti)
ingredients: 1 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, and salt, then knead in warm water to a soft dough.
Rest the dough, then divide into balls and roll out thin, brushing with oil as you fold and re-roll.
Cook each flatbread on a hot, lightly oiled griddle until puffed and lightly browned on both sides.

name: Rougaille saucisse
instructions: Brown the sausages lightly and set them aside.
Sauté the onion and garlic, then add tomatoes, thyme, ginger, and chili.
Simmer until the sauce thickens, return the sausages, and finish with fresh coriander.

name: Cari poulet (chicken curry)
instructions: Brown the chicken pieces and set them aside.
Sauté the onions and garlic, then add curry powder, turmeric, and thyme until fragrant.
Add tomatoes, potatoes, and chicken with a little water, then cover and simmer until tender.
Finish with ginger, chili, and fresh coriander.

name: Briani
ingredients: Potatoes, saffron or food colouring, and ghee
Curry powder, cumin, cardamom, and bay leaf
instructions: Marinate the chicken or mutton in yogurt and spices, then brown and set aside.
Parboil the rice with saffron or food colouring until just undercooked.
Layer the meat, fried onions, and potatoes with the rice in a heavy pot.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat until the rice is fully tender and fragrant.

name: Mine frit
instructions: Boil the noodles briefly, drain, and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the chicken or prawns until cooked, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the cabbage, carrot, and spring onions, stir-frying until crisp-tender.
Toss in the noodles with soy sauce and garlic until evenly coated and hot.

name: Bol renversé (magic bowl)
instructions: Cook the rice and keep it warm.
Stir-fry the chicken with soy sauce, chili, and a little oil.
Sauté the vegetables separately and fry an egg for each bowl.
Layer rice, meat, vegetables, and achard, then top with the fried egg.

name: Achard légumes
instructions: Blanch the cabbage, carrots, and papaya or beans briefly, then drain well.
Toast the mustard seeds and turmeric in oil, then add garlic.
Toss the vegetables with the spiced oil, vinegar, and chili.
Chill before serving so the flavors can develop.
notes: Extra prep: Resting

name: Sweet and sour chicken
ingredients: Ketchup, vinegar, sugar, and soy sauce
instructions: Coat the chicken in cornstarch and fry until golden, then set aside.
Stir-fry the onion and pepper briefly.
Add the pineapple and sauce ingredients, simmering until thickened.
Return the chicken and toss until well coated.
notes: Chicken swapped in for pork.

name: Mapo tofu
ingredients: Soy sauce, cornstarch, and Sichuan pepper
instructions: Brown the minced chicken with garlic and ginger.
Stir in the doubanjiang and fry briefly until fragrant.
Add the tofu and a little stock, simmering gently so the tofu stays intact.
Thicken with cornstarch slurry and finish with spring onions and Sichuan pepper.

name: Egg fried rice
instructions: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set them aside.
Stir-fry the carrot and spring onions briefly.
Add the rice, breaking up any clumps, and toss until hot.
Return the eggs, season with soy sauce and sesame oil, and serve.

name: Chow mein
ingredients: Soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil
instructions: Boil the noodles until just tender, drain, and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry the chicken or prawns until cooked, then set aside.
Stir-fry the cabbage, carrot, and garlic briefly.
Add the noodles, meat, and sauces, tossing everything together until hot.

name: Chicken and cabbage dumplings (jiaozi)
ingredients: 200 g cabbage, finely chopped and salted
Soy sauce, ginger, and sesame oil
instructions: Mix the minced chicken with the salted, squeezed cabbage, spring onions, garlic, and seasoning.
Place a spoonful of filling in each wrapper and fold into dumplings.
Boil or steam the dumplings until the filling is cooked through.
Serve with a soy and sesame oil dipping sauce.
notes: Chicken swapped in for pork.

name: Hot and sour soup
ingredients: Vinegar, white pepper, and chili oil
instructions: Bring the stock to a simmer and add the mushrooms and tofu.
Season with soy sauce, vinegar, and white pepper.
Thicken lightly with cornstarch slurry, then swirl in the beaten egg.
Finish with chili oil just before serving.

name: Char siu (BBQ chicken)
ingredients: 2 tbsp hoisin sauce and 1 tbsp honey
instructions: Mix the hoisin, honey, soy sauce, five-spice, garlic, and ginger into a marinade.
Marinate the chicken thighs for at least a few hours, or overnight.
Roast or grill, basting with the marinade, until caramelized and cooked through.
Rest briefly before slicing.
notes: Extra prep: Marinating. Chicken swapped in for pork.

name: Steamed fish with ginger and scallion
ingredients: 3 slices ginger and 2 spring onions, julienned
instructions: Place the fish on a plate with ginger and season lightly.
Steam until just cooked through.
Scatter spring onions over the hot fish and drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Pour a little hot oil over the top to release the aromatics, then serve.

name: Spring rolls
ingredients: Soy sauce and oil for frying
instructions: Stir-fry the minced chicken or prawns with the cabbage, carrot, and glass noodles, seasoning with soy sauce.
Cool the filling, then roll portions in the wrappers, sealing the edges.
Fry the rolls in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Drain and serve with a dipping sauce.

name: Hummus
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and juice of 1 lemon
instructions: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, garlic, and lemon juice until smooth.
Add olive oil and cumin, blending to a creamy consistency, adjusting with water as needed.
Season with salt and transfer to a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and dust with paprika before serving.

name: Falafel
ingredients: Flour, salt, and oil for frying
instructions: Blend the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, and coriander with the spices until coarsely ground.
Mix in flour and baking powder, then rest the mixture briefly.
Shape into small balls or patties.
Fry until deep golden and crisp, then drain and serve.
notes: Extra prep: Overnight soak

name: Moussaka
instructions: Salt the eggplant slices, then fry or roast until golden.
Cook the onion and garlic, add the minced meat, and brown well, then stir in tomatoes and cinnamon.
Make the bechamel sauce until thick and smooth.
Layer eggplant and meat sauce in a dish, top with bechamel, and bake until golden and set.

name: Tabbouleh
ingredients: Olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper
instructions: Soak the bulgur in water until tender, then drain well.
Finely chop the parsley, mint, tomatoes, and spring onions.
Toss everything with the bulgur, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper and chill before serving.

name: Chicken souvlaki
ingredients: 2 garlic cloves and juice of 1 lemon
instructions: Marinate the chicken cubes in garlic, lemon juice, oregano, and olive oil.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill or pan-fry, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with pita bread.
notes: Extra prep: Marinating

name: Spanakopita
ingredients: Dill, egg, olive oil, salt, and pepper
instructions: Wilt the spinach, cool, and squeeze out excess liquid, then mix with feta, onion, dill, and egg.
Layer sheets of phyllo in a baking dish, brushing each with olive oil.
Spread the spinach filling over the phyllo, then top with more buttered or oiled phyllo sheets.
Score the top and bake until golden and crisp.

name: Seafood paella
ingredients: 1 onion, 1 bell pepper, and 3 garlic cloves
Fish stock, olive oil, salt, and pepper
instructions: Sauté the onion, pepper, and garlic in olive oil, then add tomatoes and saffron.
Stir in the rice, coating it in the sofrito.
Add hot fish stock and simmer without stirring until the rice is nearly tender.
Arrange the seafood over the rice, cover, and cook until everything is tender.

name: Baklava
instructions: Layer sheets of phyllo in a baking dish, brushing each with melted butter.
Scatter the chopped nuts over the middle layers.
Cut into pieces before baking, then bake until golden and crisp.
Pour the sugar syrup over the hot baklava and let it soak in before serving.

name: Herb roast chicken
instructions: Rub the chicken all over with butter or oil, garlic, herbs, salt, and pepper.
Stuff the cavity with the lemon.
Roast until the skin is golden and the juices run clear.
Rest before carving.

name: Chicken stroganoff
instructions: Brown the chicken slices and set them aside.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms until golden.
Add stock and mustard, then return the chicken and simmer.
Stir in the sour cream and season before serving.
notes: Chicken swapped in for beef.

name: French onion soup
instructions: Cook the onions slowly in butter until deeply caramelized.
Add the stock and thyme, then simmer until the flavors meld.
Ladle into bowls, top with baguette slices and cheese.
Broil until the cheese is bubbling and golden.

name: Chicken cordon bleu
ingredients: 4 slices turkey ham and 4 slices Swiss cheese
instructions: Flatten the chicken breasts and top each with a slice of turkey ham and cheese, then roll or fold closed.
Coat in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Pan-fry or bake until golden and cooked through.
Rest briefly before serving.

name: Coq au vin
ingredients: Garlic, thyme, bay leaf, and butter
instructions: Brown the chicken pieces and turkey bacon, then set aside.
Sauté the onion, carrots, and mushrooms.
Add the wine, garlic, thyme, and bay leaf, then return the chicken and turkey bacon.
Cover and simmer until the chicken is tender and the sauce has reduced.
notes: Chicken braised in red wine — swapped in for beef bourguignon.

name: Quiche Lorraine
instructions: Blind-bake the pastry base until lightly golden.
Scatter the turkey bacon and cheese over the base.
Whisk the eggs with cream, salt, pepper, and nutmeg, then pour over the filling.
Bake until the filling is set and golden.

name: Caesar salad
ingredients: Mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, and olive oil
instructions: Grill the chicken breasts and slice once cooked.
Blend the anchovies, garlic, mustard, lemon juice, and mayonnaise into a dressing.
Toss the romaine lettuce with the dressing.
Top with sliced chicken, croutons, and parmesan.

name: Fish and chips
ingredients: 150 g flour and cold sparkling water or beer
Salt, pepper, and oil for frying
instructions: Cut the potatoes into chips and fry or cook until golden and crisp.
Whisk the flour with sparkling water or beer and baking powder into a batter.
Dip the fish in the batter and fry until golden and cooked through.
Drain and serve the fish and chips together with salt.

name: Creamy mashed potatoes
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, then drain well.
Mash while hot, or pass through a ricer.
Beat in the butter and warm milk or cream until smooth.
Season with salt, white pepper, and nutmeg.

name: Crème brûlée
ingredients: 100 g sugar, plus extra for the brulee topping
instructions: Warm the cream with the vanilla.
Whisk the egg yolks with sugar, then slowly pour in the warm cream, whisking constantly.
Strain into ramekins and bake in a water bath until just set.
Chill, then sprinkle sugar on top and caramelize with a torch or under the broiler before serving.
notes: Extra prep: Chilling

name: Spaghetti carbonara
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Render the turkey bacon with garlic until crisp.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and black pepper.
Off the heat, toss the hot pasta with the turkey bacon, then quickly mix in the egg mixture until creamy.

name: Lasagna
ingredients: 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, and 400 g tomatoes
instructions: Brown the minced chicken or turkey with onion and garlic, then add tomatoes and simmer into a ragu.
Make the bechamel sauce until smooth.
Layer lasagna sheets, ragu, and bechamel in a baking dish, repeating until the dish is full.
Top with cheese and bake until golden and bubbling.

name: Mushroom risotto
instructions: Sauté the mushrooms until golden and set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in butter, then add the rice and toast briefly.
Add the wine, then gradually add hot stock, stirring until each addition is absorbed.
Stir in the mushrooms, parmesan, and butter, and serve immediately.

name: Penne arrabbiata
instructions: Cook the penne in salted water until al dente.
Gently fry the garlic and chilies in olive oil, then add the tomatoes.
Simmer the sauce until thickened, seasoning with salt.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and finish with fresh parsley.

name: Minestrone
ingredients: Garlic, basil, olive oil, salt, and pepper
instructions: Sauté the onion, carrots, and celery in olive oil with garlic.
Add the tomatoes, beans, and stock, then simmer.
Add the pasta or rice and cook until tender.
Finish with basil, salt, and pepper before serving.

name: Bruschetta
instructions: Toast or grill the bread slices until golden.
Mix the diced tomatoes with garlic, basil, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Spoon the tomato mixture over the toasted bread.
Serve immediately while the bread is still crisp.

name: Chicken parmigiana
ingredients: 100 g flour, 2 eggs, and 150 g breadcrumbs
instructions: Coat the chicken breasts in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Fry until golden and cooked through.
Top with tomato sauce and mozzarella.
Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbling, then finish with basil.

name: Osso buco
ingredients: 400 g tomatoes and 250 ml white wine
Garlic, lemon zest, and fresh parsley (gremolata)
instructions: Dust the lamb shanks with flour and brown well, then set aside.
Sauté the onion, carrots, celery, and garlic.
Add the wine, tomatoes, and stock, then return the shanks.
Cover and simmer until the meat is tender, then finish with gremolata.

name: Tiramisu
instructions: Whisk the egg yolks with sugar until pale, then beat in the mascarpone.
Whip the egg whites to soft peaks and fold into the mascarpone mixture.
Dip the ladyfingers briefly in coffee and layer with the mascarpone mixture.
Chill for several hours, then dust with cocoa powder before serving.
notes: Extra prep: Chilling

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: Fish sauce, tamarind paste, sugar, and chili flakes
instructions: Soak the rice noodles until pliable and mix the sauce.
Stir-fry the chicken or prawns, then push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce, tossing until coated and tender.
Fold in bean sprouts and spring onions, then serve with peanuts and lime.

name: Green curry
ingredients: Thai basil, fish sauce, and lime leaves
instructions: Fry the curry paste briefly in a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until nearly done.
Add the remaining coconut milk and the vegetables, simmering until tender.
Season with fish sauce and finish with Thai basil and lime leaves.

name: Red curry
ingredients: Thai basil, fish sauce, and lime leaves
instructions: Fry the curry paste briefly in a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the meat and cook until nearly done.
Add the remaining coconut milk, bell pepper, and bamboo shoots, simmering until tender.
Season with fish sauce and finish with Thai basil and lime leaves.

name: Massaman curry
ingredients: Roasted peanuts, tamarind paste, and palm sugar
instructions: Brown the chicken, then set aside.
Fry the curry paste in a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add the chicken, remaining coconut milk, potatoes, and onion, then simmer until tender.
Stir in peanuts, tamarind paste, and palm sugar before serving.

name: Tom yum goong
ingredients: 1 L stock and 400 ml coconut milk (optional)
Fish sauce, lime juice, and chili
instructions: Bring the stock to a boil with lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves.
Add the mushrooms and tomatoes, simmering briefly.
Add the prawns and cook until just pink.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and chili off the heat.

name: Tom kha gai
ingredients: Fish sauce, lime juice, and chili
instructions: Bring the coconut milk to a simmer with lemongrass, galangal, and lime leaves.
Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through.
Add the mushrooms and cook briefly.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and chili before serving.

name: Pad kra pao (holy basil stir-fry)
ingredients: Fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar
instructions: Pound or mince the garlic and chilies together.
Stir-fry the minced chicken with the garlic and chilies until cooked.
Season with fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar, then stir in the holy basil until wilted.
Serve over rice topped with a fried egg.

name: Khao pad (Thai fried rice)
instructions: Stir-fry the chicken or prawns with the onion until cooked.
Push aside and scramble the egg.
Add the rice, breaking up clumps, and season with fish sauce and soy sauce.
Toss until hot and serve with lime and cucumber.

name: Som tam (papaya salad)
ingredients: Fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar
instructions: Pound the garlic and chilies in a mortar, then add the green beans.
Add the shredded papaya and tomatoes, lightly bruising to release the flavors.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar, tossing well.
Top with roasted peanuts and dried shrimp before serving.

name: Mango sticky rice
ingredients: Sugar and a pinch of salt
instructions: Soak the glutinous rice, then steam until tender.
Warm the coconut milk with sugar and a pinch of salt.
Stir most of the coconut mixture into the hot rice and let it absorb.
Serve the rice with sliced mango, the remaining coconut sauce, and toasted sesame seeds.
notes: Extra prep: Soak

name: Butter chicken
instructions: Marinate the chicken in some of the spices and yogurt, if time allows, then brown and set aside.
Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger, then add the tomatoes and spices.
Simmer the sauce until thickened, then blend smooth if desired.
Return the chicken, stir in the cream and butter, and finish with fresh coriander.
notes: Extra prep: Marinating

name: Chicken biryani
ingredients: Garam masala, cumin, cardamom, and bay leaf
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt and spices, then brown and set aside.
Parboil the rice with whole spices until just undercooked.
Layer the chicken, fried onions, and rice in a heavy pot with saffron and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat until the rice is fully tender and fragrant.

name: Dal tadka
ingredients: 250 g split lentils (toor or masoor dal)
Ghee or oil and fresh coriander
instructions: Boil the lentils with turmeric until soft, then set aside.
Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger, then add tomatoes and spices.
Stir the tempering into the cooked lentils and simmer briefly.
Finish with ghee and fresh coriander.

name: Aloo gobi
instructions: Sauté the onion until soft, then add turmeric, cumin, and coriander powder.
Add the potatoes and cauliflower, stirring to coat in the spices.
Add the tomatoes and a little water, then cover and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Finish with ginger, chili, and fresh coriander.

name: Rogan josh
ingredients: Kashmiri chili powder, cumin, and coriander
instructions: Brown the lamb in batches and set aside.
Sauté the onions and garlic until deeply golden.
Add the yogurt, ginger, and spices, then return the lamb with a little water.
Cover and simmer until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.

name: Garlic naan
ingredients: 150 ml warm milk and 100 g yogurt
instructions: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, and salt, then knead in warm milk and yogurt to a soft dough.
Let the dough rise until puffy.
Divide, roll out, and cook on a very hot griddle or under a broiler until puffed and charred in spots.
Brush with garlic butter immediately after cooking.
notes: Extra prep: Includes rising

name: Samosas
instructions: Make a firm dough with the flour and rest it.
Cook the potatoes and peas with the spices, ginger, and chili, then cool.
Roll out the dough, cut and shape into cones, and fill with the potato mixture.
Seal the edges and deep-fry until golden and crisp.

name: Gulab jamun
ingredients: 50 g flour and a pinch of baking soda
400 g sugar and water, for the syrup
instructions: Mix the milk powder, flour, and baking soda, adding milk gradually to form a soft dough.
Shape into small smooth balls.
Make a sugar syrup with water, cardamom, and rosewater, and keep it warm.
Fry the balls on low heat until evenly golden, then soak in the warm syrup before serving.
